lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Agent
    participant LifecycleAPI as Lifecycle Rule Injection API
    participant RulesStore as Optional Lifecycle Rules Store
    participant HookSettings as Fixed Hook Prompt Settings Store
    participant MemoryStore as Project Memory Store
    participant DesignStore as Formal Design Workspace Store

    Agent->>LifecycleAPI: adashi_get_rule_injections(intend, run.start)
    LifecycleAPI->>RulesStore: Load optional enabled SQL rules where intend and hook are exact matches
    RulesStore-->>LifecycleAPI: User-created prompt fragments only
    LifecycleAPI->>MemoryStore: Load fixed memory protocol and current project memory
    MemoryStore-->>LifecycleAPI: Memory protocol plus compact memory context

    alt intend is design
        LifecycleAPI->>HookSettings: Load fixed design/run.start authoring prompt
        HookSettings-->>LifecycleAPI: Design Authoring Hook prompt
        LifecycleAPI->>DesignStore: Read compact formal design overview and artifact metadata
        DesignStore-->>LifecycleAPI: Revision, C4 index, UML artifact types, attached artifacts, bindings
        LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: injectionPrompt includes authoring prompt plus generated design context
    else intend is implementation
        LifecycleAPI->>HookSettings: Load fixed implementation/run.start guidance prompt
        HookSettings-->>LifecycleAPI: Implementation Guidance Hook prompt
        LifecycleAPI->>DesignStore: Read compact formal design overview and implementation bindings
        DesignStore-->>LifecycleAPI: Revision, component map, relevant bindings, implementation guidance
        LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: injectionPrompt includes implementation prompt plus generated design guide
    else intend is general
        LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: injectionPrompt includes optional rules and fixed memory context only
    end

    loop For each concrete task
        Agent->>LifecycleAPI: adashi_get_rule_injections(intend, task.start)
        LifecycleAPI->>RulesStore: Load optional enabled SQL rules where intend and hook = task.start
        LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: task.start prompts only

        Agent->>LifecycleAPI: adashi_get_rule_injections(intend, task.end)
        LifecycleAPI->>RulesStore: Load optional enabled SQL rules where intend and hook = task.end
        LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: task.end prompts only
    end

    Agent->>LifecycleAPI: adashi_get_rule_injections(intend, run.end)
    LifecycleAPI->>RulesStore: Load optional enabled SQL rules where intend and hook = run.end
    LifecycleAPI-->>Agent: run.end prompts only

    Note over HookSettings: Fixed product hook prompts are edited in Settings, not listed as optional Rules
    Note over LifecycleAPI: Supported intents are general, design, implementation
    Note over LifecycleAPI: Supported hooks are run.start, task.start, task.end, run.end
